model: Altura 68 in DC (ETL model 68-ATRDC, models 68681 to 68685)
notes: A 68-inch DC ceiling fan with a hand-held remote, from the ETL guide for models 68681 to 68685. A UL-numbered Altura 68 DC guide (models 99981 to 99983) gives different wattages, so check the model number on the label before using these figures.

gaps: Conflict: the ETL guide (models 68681 to 68685) gives 3, 11 and 32 W for low, medium and high; the UL guide (models 99981 to 99983) gives 4, 20 and 36 W. The ETL figures are used.
The guide calls it a DC motor with magnetic poles but does not say brushless; the motor_bldc key follows the device template and no magnet part is claimed.
Fan speed control part RH786NR (Rhine) is named only in a safety warning and is not called the receiver, so no receiver part is claimed.
The guide mentions a light kit only as optional and its package list has none, so no light part is claimed.
The guide names no blade material, so no blade part is claimed.

The FCC grant RGB-68ATRDCR (product 68ATRDCR, 68 inch Altura) is tied to this fan because its filed user manual exhibit is this guide for ETL model 68-ATRDC; the exhibit's speed table is a blank template.
method: ETL guide: Home Decorators Collection Altura 68-inch ceiling fan use and care guide, ETL model 68-ATRDC, models 68681 to 68685 (Home Depot PDF, 32 pages, English then Spanish), read with research.js pdf; page 12 was also rendered.

Guide pages used: 2 (fan speed control part), 3 (speed table, volts and watts without lights), 5 (package contents), 12 (remote pairing and dimming switch), 13 (DC start-up oscillation note), 15 (bearings, DC motor note).
UL guide: Home Depot PDF, UL model 68-ATRDC, models 99981 to 99983, read only for its different speed table on page 3.
FCC grant page for RGB-68ATRDCR on fccid.io (King of Fans, Inc.; 68 inch Altura; product code 68ATRDCR) and its user manual exhibit 2960402 were read; the internal photos exhibit was not used.

comps.spec: DC ceiling fan motor (the guide calls it a DC motor with magnetic poles) on the 120-volt household supply; running power per speed without the light kit: 3 W low, 11 W medium, 32 W high, with airflow 3679, 6790 and 9553 CFM; the fan oscillates briefly at start-up while it calibrates
Hand-held remote (transmitter) with its batteries included (two AAA); a Learn button and a 0/1 dip switch in the battery compartment for pairing, and an ON/DIM switch for dimmable bulbs
Permanently lubricated sealed ball bearings in the motor
